reviewer.note: Round 2 review at 99aff0a3 (PR #447), docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md, round 2. Rim and planting improved, but the body is still two flat bands split by one diagonal terminator (largest one-tone region 114 texels, #ae5a42 [9,39,35,44]); the lime bloom is a ruled 1-texel line with two drips, the same stamp in the same place on all seven tubs (bodies differ by 14-38 texels); a flat dark 3x3 square sits in every lower-right corner; no soil band or far inner wall shows; leaf clumps are smooth two-tone discs; bar 0.76 -> 0.71. Compared with the Eastward 13 bell and 17 churns (rims, bands, highlights) at x1.37. Fix list: XR2-T1 to XR2-T5.
fix_list: XR2-T1: body: shade the terracotta as a vessel, not two flat bands: a lit west third (tone 4), body (tone 3), dark east (tone 1-2), and break every one-tone run over 40 texels with clay texture (2-3 texel pits, a hairline crack with a lit lip)
XR2-T2: lime bloom as irregular pale clusters under the rim (2-4 texels, varied per tub), not a ruled 1-texel line with drips; vary it on every tub
XR2-T3: remove the flat dark 3x3 square in the lower-right corner (or make it a chip with a lit lip)
XR2-T4: show a 2 px soil band and the far inner wall lit, between the clumps
XR2-T5: leaf clumps with leaf-shaped scallops and dark pockets (3-4 tones of the leaf ramp), not smooth two-tone discs; each tub its own planting
